title: Euler systems

definitions.statement: Collection of cohomology classes c_m in H^1(K_m, T) satisfying norm compatibility relation Cor(c_{mp}) = P(Frob_p^(-1)) c_m.
Classes P_n in H^1(K, E)[p^k] obtained by applying Kolyvagin derivative operators D_n to Heegner points.
Sha(E/Q) = ker(H^1(Q, E) -> prod_v H^1(Q_v, E)), measuring failure of Hasse local-to-global principle.

theorems.label: Kolyvagin's Theorem
theorems.statement: If L(E, 1) != 0, then rank E(Q) = 0 and Sha(E/Q) is finite. If L(E, 1) = 0 and L'(E, 1) != 0, then rank E(Q) = 1 and Sha(E/Q) is finite.

theorems.label: Selmer Group Annihilation
theorems.statement: Euler system classes annihilate the dual Selmer group, bounding the size of Sha(E/Q).

conjectures.label: Finiteness of Sha(E/Q)
conjectures.statement: Sha(E/Q) is finite for all elliptic curves E/Q of arbitrary rank r.

open_gaps: Euler systems constructed from Heegner points control Selmer groups only when analytic rank is 0 or 1. No Euler system is known for rank >= 2.
computational_handles: Verification of triviality or order of Sha(E) via analytic quotient.
Evaluation of local Tamagawa numbers c_p via Tate's algorithm.

citations.ref: Kolyvagin, V.A. (1990). Euler systems, The Grothendieck Festschrift, Vol. II, Progr. Math., 87, Birkhäuser, 435-483.
